jobs.occupation: Kitchen Help Industrial Kitchen - Aalter - 2 Shifts
jobs.description:
Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or a perfectly cooked roast beef: you’ll be licking your fingers and thumbs. And in this role, you’ll make sure others can do the same. In our kitchen, we create dishes that would make grandmothers jealous—but on an industrial scale, in large quantities.
 

We’re looking for a Kitchen Help for a food company in Aalter!
 

Hygiene is crucial for a kitchen staff member. That’s why you’ll ensure every day that your work methods and the final products meet all standards.
 

You’ll also follow safety regulations to the letter. You’ll do everything in your power to guarantee both quality and safety. 
 

 

Who are you?

• You have experience as a cook in a commercial or industrial kitchen. Do you also have experience in a production environment? If so, that’s a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system.
• The early shift starts at 4:30 a.m. and runs until 12:30 p.m.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 p.m. and runs until 8:00 p.m.
• You know how to operate machinery or are willing to undergo training for this.
• Physical work doesn’t deter you, and you’re hands-on.
• You work with great precision and are flexible and able to handle stress.
• You’re a good communicator, enjoy variety, and like working in a team.
• You speak Dutch or English well.

jobs.occupation: SAP Manufacturing Specialist - PE, QM & PPDS
jobs.description:
About the role

This role focuses on production-centric SAP processes in a manufacturing environment, with a strong emphasis on SAP PE, QM and PPDS.

You lead and contribute to end-to-end SAP implementations across the full lifecycle: fit-gap analysis, configuration, functional design, training, UAT, data collection and migration, go-live support, and final documentation. You work closely with logistics, controlling, procurement and other business areas to ensure reliable SAP integration across domains.

In collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders and production teams, you help define detailed, scalable and sustainable processes. You can quickly understand complex business flows, challenge stakeholders to sharpen their needs, and convert those requirements into structured SAP solutions in both template-driven and customized environments.

You also support business users through clear communication, maintain alignment between domains, and contribute to successful deployments in an international context.

Key responsibilities

• Drive and support SAP delivery throughout the full implementation lifecycle, from analysis to go-live and documentation.
• Design, improve and support production-related SAP processes within a manufacturing setting.
• Translate business requirements into robust functional solutions across connected SAP domains.
• Collaborate with stakeholders from logistics, controlling, procurement and production to safeguard process consistency and integration.
• Contribute to deployment activities, including additional travel when needed during go-live periods.
Scope

• Production Execution (PE): strong expertise in SAP PE processes in a manufacturing context, including shop floor integration and execution flows.
• Quality Management (QM): solid experience in SAP QM, ideally combined with integration with Labvantage or a similar LIMS platform.
• PPDS: good understanding of Production Planning and Detailed Scheduling, with the ability to link planning and execution processes.
• Experience with EWM integration is an advantage.
• Experience in greenfield implementations is a plus.
Work environment

You work in an international, multicultural environment with regular on-site presence in Hoboken and travel when required, including possible extra travel during go-live phases.

• Proven experience with end-to-end SAP implementations.
• Strong expertise in SAP integration across domains, including logistics, controlling and procurement.
• Hands-on experience with SAP PE, QM and PPDS in a manufacturing company.
• PPDS knowledge is preferred but not mandatory.
• Familiarity with integration with Labvantage or a comparable LIMS platform, and preferably EWM.
• Ability to debug and troubleshoot SAP issues is a plus.
• You communicate clearly, in a structured and business-oriented way, and can explain complex solutions simply to stakeholders.
• You are comfortable challenging the business to uncover underlying requirements.
• You work effectively with both business stakeholders and technical colleagues and build strong working relationships.
• You show a proactive mindset, resilience under pressure and flexibility when priorities change.
• You are willing to be on site in Hoboken every week.
• You are fluent in English.
• Good French is required to support project activities for the Grenoble deployment.
• Polish is a plus.
• A bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
• SAP certification is an asset, but hands-on experience is considered more important.

A growing company that provides bespoke packaging and storage services for frozen and chilled food products for European customers. By 2027, the company aims to have over 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging orders. You'll work in a respectful environment where teamwork and job satisfaction are key.

For a client in the Roeselare region, within the food sector, Let's Work is looking for an experienced forklift operator for day shifts.

Your main responsibilities will include the safe handling and storage of goods, operating the forklift to a height of up to 8 metres and ensuring a smooth flow of goods to the packaging department. On top of that, you can count on a starting wage of €15.23 per hour, meal vouchers worth €7 per day and attractive working hours from 8.00 am to 4.30 pm.

Are you looking for a great logistics job on the day shift? Be sure to read on!

What will you be handling as a forklift operator?

 
• 
You'll spend most of your day (±90%) operating the forklift

 
• 
You'll be placing octabins and pallets at heights of up to 8 metres in the warehouse

 
• 
You'll be responsible for delivering products to be packaged to the packaging department

 
• 
You scan labels and locations correctly into the system

 
• 
During your work, you ensure a smooth and organised flow of goods

 
• 
You hold a valid forklift certificate

 
• 
You have at least 2 years' experience as a forklift operator, including working at height

 
• 
You communicate fluently in English to work effectively with colleagues

Working in a cold environment (deep-freeze), using a heated forklift truck, is in line with your expectations

Working accurately and respecting safety are second nature to you
